title: 选择的代价：完备、可组合与可传递的三维权衡——复杂知识系统如何形成、演化与更新 / The Price of Choice: The Impossibility Triangle of Completeness, Composability, and Transfer
description:
本书把作者此前三本书中三处“无法弥合的矛盾”诊断为同一个结构性困境：任何有限复杂度的知识系统，都不能同时完整地拥有局部完备性（Completeness, C）、可组合性（Composability, A）与跨尺度传递性（Transferability, T）；至多同时满足两个。《遗忘的边界》选择了 C+T，让出 A（子模性：能力不能线性相加）；《区分的语法》选择了 C+A，让出 T（离散完备到连续传递之间差一个因子 1/3）；《错位的时间》选择了 A+T，让出 C（时间错配 τ 增大时置信区间发散）。本书把这三处症状收成一条可以被检查、也可以被反驳的约束，并在生命、物理、社会、人工四个战场做现实诊断，随后把“复杂知识系统如何形成、演化与更新”写成一部连续重新选择三角的历史：形成是初始选择（C+T），演化是连续换顶点（教学化 A+T、工程化 C+A），更新是能否定期恢复被让出的顶点（制度性飞地与优雅降级）。全书以 A/B/C 证据等级与 append-only 可证伪登记簿组织；三角命题本身标注为框架（C／丙），不主张为已证定理；并照实记录作者本人两次被自己脚本推翻的强主张（附录 J）。本版另含：第 2 章的形式化（系统四元组、复杂度三分量、可测量坐标 (c,a,t)、记账不等式）、第二部分每章的定量诊断与历史脉络、以及附录 K—Q（案例数据库、研究议题库、系列对应、计算与系统论、意识/AI/人机协作、四个延伸战场、知识演化指标）。

源码、构建流程、可复现脚本与可证伪登记簿见 GitHub。内容许可 CC BY 4.0；代码许可 MIT。

English. This monograph diagnoses three “unbridgeable contradictions” from the author's previous three books as one structural predicament: any knowledge system of bounded complexity cannot fully possess local Completeness (C), Composability (A), and cross-scale Transferability (T) at once — at most two. The three books are shown to occupy the three vertices: C+T conceding A (submodularity), C+A conceding T (a factor-of-1/3 gap between discrete completeness and continuous transfer), and A+T conceding C (the confidence interval diverges as the temporal mismatch τ grows). The book turns these symptoms into a checkable and refutable constraint, diagnoses four battlefields (life, physics, society, artifacts), and frames the formation, evolution, and renewal of complex knowledge systems as a continuous re-selection of the triangle: formation is the initial choice (C+T), evolution is switching vertices (didactic A+T, engineering C+A), and renewal is whether the conceded vertex can be periodically recovered through institutional enclaves and graceful degradation. Claims are graded A/B/C; the triangle is labelled a framework (C), not a proven theorem; and two of the author's own strong claims, falsified by his own scripts, are kept on record (Appendix J). This edition adds a formalization of the triangle (a four-tuple system, a three-component complexity budget, measurable coordinates (c,a,t), and a bookkeeping inequality), quantitative and historical sections for every battlefield, and Appendices K—Q (case database, research agenda, series correspondence, computation and systems theory, consciousness/AI/human-machine collaboration, four extended battlefields, and evolution indicators).

系列。本系列的通俗读本《只能选两样》与外部登记库（跨域盲测登记、最小可验证单元、合并术语表）见 github.com/lyp0746/knowledge-tradeoffs。
